behaviors.description: Enumerate cached remote commits while the server advertises another version.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent multi-app A/B repository versions served over request-recording HTTP.
behaviors.expected: Cached rows preserve exact membership and previous commit identities without network requests; ordinary queries refresh commits in both directions.

behaviors.description: Include an otherwise hidden locale extension in remote enumeration.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent repository contains normal apps/runtimes and a locale extension.
behaviors.expected: Default/all/default queries differ only by the known hidden locale ref and preserve exact ordinary ref membership.

behaviors.description: Filter remote applications by their declared runtime.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent applications consume two different runtime identities.
behaviors.expected: Unfiltered query contains all apps; each runtime filter returns exactly its consumers and an absent-runtime filter returns no rows.

behaviors.description: Show remote ref details through the documented all-columns alias.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent multi-app, multi-branch repository with known commits.
behaviors.expected: Details equal columns=all, differ from ordinary output, and contain exactly the expected identities, architectures, branches and independently prepared commits.

mappings.rationale: Recorded transfers and independent A/B commit maps contrast cached and refreshed listings.

surface_assertions.rationale: Cached enumeration retains the warmed commits and makes no network requests across two server changes.

mappings.rationale: Exact ref sets compare hidden locale membership with and without all.

surface_assertions.rationale: The independently advertised locale extension appears only with all while ordinary refs remain present.

mappings.rationale: Opposing runtime consumers and an absent-runtime control reject ignored or inverted filtering.

surface_assertions.rationale: Each runtime selects its exact independent consumer set and excludes the other runtime's applications.

mappings.rationale: Alias equivalence is checked alongside independent ref/commit expectations and an ordinary-output contrast.

surface_assertions.rationale: Detailed output equals all columns and exposes the expected arch, branch and commit for every selected app.
